title: Mobile Gallery enquiry (DESIGN ONLY — not implemented, nothing stored)
description: Proposed shape of a future homeowner enquiry to a participating Mobile Gallery provider. PRIVATE CONCEPT, 3 Nov 2026. No form, Worker, database table or Airtable field exists for this. Personal data fields would need a privacy-notice update, a retention period and founder approval before any collection. No commercial model is agreed: referral_outcome records facts only and implies no fee.

reference.description: Like the PlotArt enquiry relay's PA-E-… references.

provider_id.description: An id from MG_PROVIDERS whose status is 'participating'.

homeowner_location.description: County and optional town only. Never a street address at enquiry stage.

referral_outcome.description: Reported by the provider, never inferred. Kept separate from any commercial ledger.

contact.description: FUTURE ONLY. Name and email/phone would be held by the enquiry relay, passed to the provider with Reply-To, and deleted on a fixed schedule — as the PlotArt enquiry relay does. Not collected in the prototype.

notice_version.description: Privacy notice version shown at the time of the enquiry.
